Name: Judas, Son of James
Summary: Judas son of James was one of the twelve apostles, listed by Luke and in Acts. Matthew and Mark call him Thaddaeus, and Matthew adds the name Lebbaeus. At the Last Supper he asked Jesus why He would manifest Himself to the disciples and not to the world.
KeyStory: Thaddaeus asked the question every disciple wonders: Lord, why do You show Yourself to us and not to the world?
RelatedPeople: Jesus; Simon Peter; James, Son of Alphaeus
LifeLesson: A quiet apostle asked one honest question at the table. Jesus answered that love keeps His word, and the Father comes to dwell.
